description: [Trip-Pups(트립펍스) — 외국인 축제 찾기·신청] Find festivals, fairs and events in Korea (currently Seoul and Gangwon) that overlap a travel date range. Only events whose foreign-visitor access is confirmed by an official page or the organizer are returned; say so if the list is short. Results also include small-group meetups hosted by Trip-Pups for international students and travelers in Seoul (marked hosted_by: trippups, with their sign-up link). Use get_event for sign-up steps, official link and transport.

interests.description: e.g. food, music, kpop, art, tradition, nature, night, winter, expo

limit.description: How many events per page (default 10, max 20)

region.description: seoul, gangwon, or a city or district inside them such as Gangneung, Sokcho, Gangnam, Insadong (Korean names also accepted). Omit for both. Other places are not covered yet.

name: search_events
title: Search Korean festivals & events
